methodology.stages: normal=origin/main plus published Tooltip 2.2.0; native=frozen native PR plus frozen native Tooltip source; optimized=current optimization PR plus optimized Tooltip source. Optional optimized-fixed-native-tooltip isolates the consumer's own optimization.
methodology.scheduling: Three sequential trials rotate stage order. No concurrent tests/builds/benchmarks. Each SSR trial warms 1000 times and collects 31 samples of 100 renders. All raw samples retained.
methodology.interpretation: Compare spread across independent process trials before describing runtime improvements. No timing thresholds are asserted. Closed SSR does not represent browser interaction cost.
methodology.dependencyBoundary: No package lock or published version is faked. Native/optimized Tooltips are explicit source aliases; publish native Tooltips before refreshing dependent locks in a future release.

sourceTree.includes: src/**, package.json, bun.lock, tailwind.css and theme.css when present

methodology.scheduling: Run serially on the same host after test/build processes finish. No timing assertions.
methodology.timing: performance.now; one sample is 100 synchronous renderToStaticMarkup calls divided by 100; samples retain original order; nearest-rank p95.
methodology.bundle: Bun production browser bundle of representative named exports, minified; gzip level 9; shared consumer peers external; tooltip dependency is bundled.
methodology.ssr: Bun production SSR bundle; all React/ReactDOM imports resolve to this package root to prevent duplicate React instances; tree constructed before timing.
limitations: Closed-widget SSR measures server rendering, not interaction latency, layout, accessibility or browser memory.
Bundle byte counts exclude shared React/ReactDOM, icon and Motion peers and CSS.
Single-machine observations can vary; no performance pass/fail threshold is inferred.

methodology.timing: No latency measurements or timing assertions; operation counters and explicit outcome checks. Finite Web Animations finish before counters reset/capture; shared CSS disables transitions/animations for deterministic end-state visual parity.
methodology.instrumentation: Native DOM/observer constructors and public render callbacks/getters count real work. Calendar constrainCalendarDateTime and getYearOptions entries are counted only in the in-memory production bundle; no implementation is mocked.
methodology.parity: Normalized DOM with all non-style attributes, an explicit computed-style selection and decoded in-memory viewport RGBA pixels after each operation; screenshot files are never written.
limitations: Observer delivery and rectangle counts may vary between browser scheduling turns; retain all trials.
Shared compiled playground CSS is fixed for all stages of a package.
A disabled getter counts option model work, not private function invocations.
Toast content reads use an identity-preserving public store facade. Frozen facade snapshot arrays can add one probe-owned freeze for a changed snapshot, but none for true no-op updates.

results.validity: all explicit final-state assertions passed; no browser exceptions
